About.intro: Pulse is a digital magazine for people who want to step away from the noise and reconnect with nature, thoughtful ideas, and themselves.
About.philosophyDesc1: Pulse is a digital magazine built for slow reading. No pop-ups, no autoplay, no endless feed — just long-form stories about nature, stillness, and the small rituals that bring you back to yourself. Every page is paced like a walk through the woods: unhurried, and worth the time.
About.philosophyDesc2: Open it when the day feels loud. Close it feeling like you actually breathed.
About.aboutDesc1: We believe the internet can be a place for stillness too. Pulse brings together stories, photography and ideas around nature and slow living without unnecessary noise.
About.aboutDesc2: Every piece is created to give you a few quiet minutes away from the constant rhythm of the digital world.

AboutPage.intro: A full-stack developer who builds calm, well-made products — and Pulse is one of them.
AboutPage.whyTitle: Built out of a simple frustration
AboutPage.whyDesc1: Most of the internet is built to keep you scrolling. Pulse started as the opposite idea — a place to actually finish reading something, without ads fighting for your attention or an algorithm deciding what's next.
AboutPage.whyDesc2: I designed and built every part of it — from the reading experience down to the editor writers use to publish — the way I'd want to use it myself.
AboutPage.prexDesc: Pulse is built and maintained by PREX, a software agency I run focused on crafting digital products for the Egyptian market. Pulse is one of ours — start to finish.

zeroDistractions.title: Zero Distractions
zeroDistractions.text: No ads, no pop-ups, no autoplay video. Just the words and the space around them.

natureThemes.title: Nature-Led Themes
natureThemes.text: Every layout borrows its rhythm from the outdoors — soft light, natural texture, room to breathe.

mindfulPacing.title: Mindful Pacing
mindfulPacing.text: Stories are written and formatted to be read slowly, not skimmed. Long-form, on purpose.

curated.title: Curated, Not Endless
curated.text: A small, hand-picked library instead of an infinite feed. Quality over volume, always.

slowLiving.title: Slow Living
slowLiving.text: Thoughts and stories about creating a quieter, more intentional life.

intoNature.title: Into Nature
intoNature.text: Places, landscapes and moments that invite you to slow down.

quietMinds.title: Quiet Minds
quietMinds.text: Simple ideas for finding clarity in a noisy digital world.

oneThing.title: The Art of Doing One Thing at a Time
oneThing.excerpt: Why single-tasking through a rainy morning taught me more than any productivity app ever did.

forestPatience.title: What the Forest Teaches About Patience
forestPatience.excerpt: A season doesn't rush itself — notes from three months of watching one trail change.

screensOff.title: Screens Off, Senses On
screensOff.excerpt: A simple weekly ritual for putting the phone down without feeling like you're missing out.

whatIsPulse.a: Pulse is a digital magazine focused on nature, mindfulness, slow living and thoughtful digital experiences.

isFree.a: Yes. Every story on Pulse is free, ad-free, and always will be. We're funded by readers who choose to support us directly, not by advertisers.

howOften.q: How often do you publish new stories?
howOften.a: A couple of times a week. We'd rather publish one story worth your time than five that aren't.

guestWriters.a: We do. If you write about nature, mindfulness, or slow living, reach out through the contact form below with a sample of your work.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro1: We tried to keep this readable rather than burying it in boilerplate. It covers the basics: what you can expect from Pulse, and what we expect from you.
terms.introNote: Note: this is placeholder legal content drafted for a template — have it reviewed by a lawyer before it governs a live product.

acceptance.heading: 1. Using Pulse
acceptance.body: By creating an account or reading a story on Pulse, you're agreeing to these terms. If something here doesn't sit right with you, the simplest option is not to use the platform — but we'd genuinely rather you told us instead, so we can fix it.

accounts.heading: 2. Your Account
accounts.body1: You're responsible for keeping your login details private and for anything that happens under your account. If you signed up with Google or GitHub, the same applies — we just trust them to verify who you are.
accounts.body2: You need to be old enough to legally agree to these terms in your country. If we find an account that doesn't meet that bar, we may suspend it.

content.heading: 3. Stories You Publish
content.body1: When you write a post on Pulse, it stays yours. Publishing it here gives us permission to host, display, and distribute it on the platform — nothing more. We don't claim ownership of your words.
content.body2: You're responsible for what you publish. Don't post anything you don't have the right to share, and don't use Pulse to publish content that's illegal, harassing, or knowingly false.

conduct.heading: 4. Community Guidelines
conduct.body: Pulse is built around slow, thoughtful reading — we'd like the comments and interactions here to match that. Be respectful, don't spam, and don't try to manipulate likes, views, or comment counts. Accounts that consistently break this may be limited or removed.

termination.heading: 5. Suspending or Closing an Account
termination.body: You can delete your account at any time. We may suspend or remove an account that violates these terms, with notice where reasonably possible.

disclaimer.heading: 6. No Guarantees
disclaimer.body: Pulse is provided "as is." We work to keep it reliable and the content accurate, but we can't promise it will always be available, error-free, or exactly what you expected — especially while the platform is actively evolving.

changes.heading: 7. Changes to These Terms
changes.body: We may update these terms as Pulse grows. If a change is significant, we'll do our best to let you know before it takes effect. Continuing to use Pulse after an update means you accept the new terms.

contact.heading: 8. Contact
contact.bodySuffix: . Questions about these terms can be sent through the contact details on the PREX website.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro1: Your data isn't the product here — the stories are. This page covers what we collect, why, and how you're in control of it.
privacy.introNote: Note: this is placeholder legal content drafted for a template — have it reviewed by a lawyer before it governs a live product.

overview.heading: 1. Overview
overview.body: This explains what Pulse collects when you use the platform, why, and what say you have over it. We collect as little as we reasonably can — a reading platform doesn't need to know much about you to work well.

collect.heading: 2. What We Collect
collect.accountInfoText: your name, email, and password (or your Google/GitHub identity if you sign in that way).
collect.usageText: basic analytics like which stories are read or liked, used to power features like "Most Viewed."

use.heading: 3. How We Use It
use.body: To run your account, show you the content you've interacted with, keep the platform secure, and understand which stories resonate so we can publish more of what's actually worth reading.

cookies.heading: 4. Cookies
cookies.body: We use a small number of cookies to keep you logged in and remember your preferences. We don't use cookies to sell your data or track you across other sites.

thirdParty.heading: 5. Third-Party Services
thirdParty.body: We use trusted providers to run parts of Pulse — for example, image hosting for cover photos, and Google/GitHub if you choose to sign in with them. These providers only receive what's needed to perform their function.

retention.heading: 6. How Long We Keep It
retention.body: We keep your data for as long as your account is active. If you delete your account, we remove your personal information within a reasonable period, except where we're required to keep it longer for legal reasons.

rights.heading: 7. Your Rights
rights.body: You can access, correct, or delete your personal data at any time from your account settings, or by reaching out to us directly.

children.heading: 8. Children's Privacy
children.body: Pulse isn't directed at children, and we don't knowingly collect data from anyone below the age required to hold an account in their country.

changes.heading: 9. Changes to This Policy
changes.body: If this policy changes in a meaningful way, we'll update the date at the top of this page and, where appropriate, let you know directly.

contact.heading: 10. Contact
contact.bodySuffix: . For privacy questions or requests, reach out through the contact details on the PREX website.
